titulo_ja: げんかい と じょうけん (1)

やる.es: hacer; llevar a cabo (forma de diccionario)

まもります.en: I will respect; I will respect

texto: To say that, as you have already decided something, you must act accordingly: phrase in normal form + **から に は**: **やる と きめた からには、 さいご まで やります** (now that I have decided, I will do it to the end).

texto: To say that, as something has happened, the consequence is logical: phrase in normal form + **いじょう は**: **やくそく した いじょうは、 まもります** (since I have promised, I will fulfill it).

intro: Today you learn to say that, as you have already made a decision or a promise, now you have to keep it. They are phrases of commitment and responsibility.
